request.subject: UNIT:CULT:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn the gondola into a living kraken at the surface: one big round deep indigo-blue head-body low in the water with one big glowing green eye at the front, five thick curling tentacles with cream suckers, two of them wearing a brass ring; lit from the lower left. No boat, mast, sail or lantern. Keep the size, waterline, thick black outline and style, nothing under the body.
